title: mail: JMAP method dispatch (POST /jmap/api)
description:
Implement POST /jmap/api in crates/mail/src/jmap/dispatch.rs: parse Request, iterate methodCalls, route each Invocation to a registered method handler by name, collect responses into Response. Return 400 for unparseable JSON (notJSON error), 200 with methodResponse errors for unknown methods (unknownMethod). Handler registration uses a HashMap<&str, BoxedHandler>.

Why: the dispatch layer is the backbone; all method implementations are registered here.

Acceptance: a request with an unknown method name returns {type: urn:ietf:params:jmap:error:unknownMethod} in the response.
